    ‖towerPoint k‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (tower M)

name: InverseGenerator.norm_towerPoint_sq
statement: theorem norm_towerPoint_sq (k : ℕ) : ‖towerPoint k‖ ^ 2 = (tower (k + 1) : ℝ)

name: InverseGenerator.norm_towerPoint_sub
statement:
theorem norm_towerPoint_sub (k : ℕ) :
    ‖towerPoint (k + 1) - towerPoint k‖ = (tower (k + 1) : ℝ) - (tower k : ℝ)

name: InverseGenerator.norm_towerSpec_le
statement: theorem norm_towerSpec_le (k : ℕ) : ‖towerSpec k‖ ≤ 1/(tower k : ℝ)

name: InverseGenerator.norm_towerSpec_sub_le_inv
statement:
theorem norm_towerSpec_sub_le_inv (k : ℕ) :
    ‖towerSpec (k + 1) - towerSpec k‖ ≤ 1 / (tower k : ℝ)

name: InverseGenerator.re_ofReal_mul_towerSpec
statement:
theorem re_ofReal_mul_towerSpec (t : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ((t:ℂ) * towerSpec k).re = -(t/(tower (k+1) : ℝ))

name: InverseGenerator.shifted_flow_variation_le_ten
statement:
theorem shifted_flow_variation_le_ten {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) (M : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range M,
      ‖Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (towerSpec (k + 1) + (((tower (M + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)))
        - Complex.exp ((t : ℂ) * (towerSpec k + (((tower (M + 1) : ℝ)⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ)))‖
      ≤ 10

name: InverseGenerator.sum_exp_two_pow_le_five
statement:
theorem sum_exp_two_pow_le_five (J : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ Finset.range J, Real.exp (-(((2 : ℝ) ^ j - 1) / 9)) ≤ 5

name: InverseGenerator.sum_inv_tower_tail_le
statement: theorem sum_inv_tower_tail_le (N M : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico N M, (1:ℝ)/tower k ≤ 2/tower N

name: InverseGenerator.sum_norm_towerPoint_sub_le
statement:
theorem sum_norm_towerPoint_sub_le (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, ‖towerPoint (k + 1) - towerPoint k‖ ≤ (tower N : ℝ)

name: InverseGenerator.sum_norm_towerSpec_sub_le_one
statement:
theorem sum_norm_towerSpec_sub_le_one (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.range N, ‖towerSpec (k + 1) - towerSpec k‖ ≤ 1

name: InverseGenerator.towerSpec_re
statement: theorem towerSpec_re (k : ℕ) : (towerSpec k).re = -(1/(tower (k+1) : ℝ))

name: InverseGenerator.tower_le_succ
statement: theorem tower_le_succ (k : ℕ) : tower k ≤ tower (k + 1)

name: InverseGenerator.tower_le_tower
statement: theorem tower_le_tower {j k : ℕ} (h : j ≤ k) : tower j ≤ tower k

name: InverseGenerator.two_pow_mul_tower_le
statement: theorem two_pow_mul_tower_le (N j : ℕ) : 2 ^ j * tower N ≤ tower (N + j)

name: InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_le_of_mulVec
statement:
theorem l2_opNorm_le_of_mulVec {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℂ n,
      ‖(EuclideanSpace.equiv m ℂ).symm (Matrix.mulVec A x)‖ ≤ C * ‖x‖) :
    ‖A‖ ≤ C

name: InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_le_of_schur
statement:
theorem l2_opNorm_le_of_schur {R : Matrix m n ℂ} {u : m → ℝ} {v : n → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (hv : ∀ q, 0 < v q) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hrow : ∀ p, ∑ q, ‖R p q‖ * v q ≤ C * u p)
    (hcol : ∀ q, ∑ p, ‖R p q‖ * u p ≤ C * v q) :
    ‖R‖ ≤ C

name: InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_le_of_sum_sq
statement:
theorem l2_opNorm_le_of_sum_sq {A : Matrix m n ℂ} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : ∀ x : n → ℂ, ∑ p, ‖∑ q, A p q * x q‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 * ∑ q, ‖x q‖ ^ 2) :
    ‖A‖ ≤ C

name: InverseGenerator.schur_sum_sq
statement:
theorem schur_sum_sq {R : Matrix m n ℂ} {u : m → ℝ} {v : n → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (hv : ∀ q, 0 < v q) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hrow : ∀ p, ∑ q, ‖R p q‖ * v q ≤ C * u p)
    (hcol : ∀ q, ∑ p, ‖R p q‖ * u p ≤ C * v q)
    (x : n → ℂ) :
    ∑ p, ‖∑ q, R p q * x q‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 * ∑ q, ‖x q‖ ^ 2

name: InverseGenerator.sqrt_sum_sq_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem sqrt_sum_sq_mulVec_le {A : Matrix m n ℂ} (x : n → ℂ) :
    Real.sqrt (∑ p, ‖∑ q, A p q * x q‖ ^ 2) ≤ ‖A‖ * Real.sqrt (∑ q, ‖x q‖ ^ 2)

name: InverseGenerator.binomCoeff_ofReal
statement:
theorem binomCoeff_ofReal (r : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    ((binomCoeff r θ : ℝ) : ℂ) = binomCoeff r ((θ : ℂ))

name: InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_signMult_le'
statement:
theorem l2_opNorm_signMult_le' {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α < 1) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ‖signMult n ((α : ℂ))‖ ≤ 2 * (n : ℝ) ^ α

name: InverseGenerator.le_l2_opNorm_signMult'
statement:
theorem le_l2_opNorm_signMult' {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ α / 2 ≤ ‖signMult n ((α : ℂ))‖

name: InverseGenerator.norm_toeplitz_apply
statement:
theorem norm_toeplitz_apply (θ : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) :
    ‖toeplitz n ((θ : ℂ)) i j‖
      = if (j : ℕ) ≤ (i : ℕ) then |binomCoeff ((i : ℕ) - (j : ℕ)) θ| else 0

name: InverseGenerator.signMult_ofReal
statement:
theorem signMult_ofReal (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) :
    signMult n (((α / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((α / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) = signMult n ((α : ℂ))

name: InverseGenerator.toeplitz_col_l1_le
statement:
theorem toeplitz_col_l1_le (θ : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (j : Fin n) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, ‖toeplitz n ((θ : ℂ)) i j‖ ≤ ∑ r ∈ range n, |binomCoeff r θ|

name: InverseGenerator.toeplitz_neg_ofReal
statement:
theorem toeplitz_neg_ofReal (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) :
    toeplitz n (-((α : ℝ) : ℂ)) = toeplitz n (((-α : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: InverseGenerator.toeplitz_row_l1_le
statement:
theorem toeplitz_row_l1_le (θ : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    ∑ j : Fin n, ‖toeplitz n ((θ : ℂ)) i j‖ ≤ ∑ r ∈ range n, |binomCoeff r θ|

name: InverseGenerator.toeplitz_row_sum
statement:
theorem toeplitz_row_sum (θ : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    ∑ j : Fin n, toeplitz n ((θ : ℂ)) i j = ((coeffProd θ (i : ℕ) : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: InverseGenerator.cast_add_ne_zero
statement: theorem cast_add_ne_zero {p q : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) : ((p : K) + q) ≠ 0

name: InverseGenerator.convolution
statement:
theorem convolution (θ : K) (p q : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    ∑ r ∈ range (q + 1), binomCoeff (p + q - r) θ * binomCoeff r (-θ)
      = binomCoeff p θ * ((p : K) / ((p : K) + q)) * binomCoeff q (1 - θ)

name: InverseGenerator.convolution_mul
statement:
theorem convolution_mul (θ : K) : ∀ (q p : ℕ),
    ((p : K) + q) * ∑ r ∈ range (q + 1),
        binomCoeff (p + q - r) θ * binomCoeff r (-θ)
      = (p : K) * binomCoeff p θ * binomCoeff q (1 - θ)

name: InverseGenerator.prefixConj_apply
statement:
theorem prefixConj_apply {n : ℕ} (k : ℕ) (θ : K) (i j : Fin n) :
    prefixConj n k θ i j
      = ∑ l : Fin n, toeplitz n θ i l * (if (l : ℕ) < k then 1 else 0)
          * toeplitz n (-θ) l j

name: InverseGenerator.prefixConj_apply_lower
statement:
theorem prefixConj_apply_lower {n : ℕ} (k : ℕ) (θ : K) (hk : k ≤ n) (i j : Fin n)
    (hi : k ≤ (i : ℕ)) (hj : (j : ℕ) < k) :
    prefixConj n k θ i j
      = schurKernel θ ((i : ℕ) - k + 1) (k - (j : ℕ) - 1)

name: InverseGenerator.prefixConj_apply_right
statement:
theorem prefixConj_apply_right {n : ℕ} (k : ℕ) (θ : K) (i j : Fin n)
    (hj : k ≤ (j : ℕ)) :
    prefixConj n k θ i j = 0

name: InverseGenerator.prefixConj_apply_upper
statement:
theorem prefixConj_apply_upper {n : ℕ} (k : ℕ) (θ : K) (i j : Fin n)
    (hi : (i : ℕ) < k) :
    prefixConj n k θ i j = if i = j then 1 else 0

name: InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_lowBlock_le'
statement:
theorem l2_opNorm_lowBlock_le' {θ : ℝ} (hθ : |θ| < 1 / 2) {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    ‖lowBlock n k ((θ : ℂ))‖ ≤ sharpPrefixConst θ

name: InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_lowBlock_le_of_kernel
statement:
theorem l2_opNorm_lowBlock_le_of_kernel {θ c : ℝ} (hθ : |θ| < 1 / 2) (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hker : ∀ {p : ℕ}, 1 ≤ p → ∀ q : ℕ, ‖schurKernel ((θ : ℂ)) p q‖
      ≤ c * (p : ℝ) ^ θ * ((q : ℝ) + 1) ^ (-θ) / ((p : ℝ) + q))
    {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    ‖lowBlock n k ((θ : ℂ))‖ ≤ c / (1 / 2 - θ) + c / (1 / 2 + θ)

name: InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_prefixConj_sub_le
statement:
theorem l2_opNorm_prefixConj_sub_le {θ : ℝ} (hθ : |θ| < 1 / 2) {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) :
    ‖prefixConj n k ((θ : ℂ)) - prefixProj n k‖ ≤ sharpPrefixConst θ

name: InverseGenerator.lowBlock_apply
statement:
theorem lowBlock_apply {n k : ℕ} (θ : K) (i j : Fin n) :
    lowBlock n k θ i j
      = if k ≤ (i : ℕ) ∧ (j : ℕ) < k then schurKernel θ ((i : ℕ) - k + 1) (k - (j : ℕ) - 1)
        else 0

name: InverseGenerator.norm_schurKernel_le'
statement:
theorem norm_schurKernel_le' {θ : ℝ} (hθ : |θ| < 1 / 2) {p : ℕ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (q : ℕ) :
    ‖schurKernel ((θ : ℂ)) p q‖
      ≤ 3 / 2 * |θ| * (p : ℝ) ^ θ * ((q : ℝ) + 1) ^ (-θ) / ((p : ℝ) + q)

name: InverseGenerator.prefixConj_eq_add
statement:
theorem prefixConj_eq_add {n k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ n) (θ : K) :
    prefixConj n k θ = prefixProj n k + lowBlock n k θ

name: InverseGenerator.schurKernel_ofReal
statement:
theorem schurKernel_ofReal (θ : ℝ) (p q : ℕ) :
    ((schurKernel θ p q : ℝ) : ℂ) = schurKernel ((θ : ℂ)) p q

name: InverseGenerator.schur_col_sum_le_of_kernel
statement:
theorem schur_col_sum_le_of_kernel {θ c : ℝ} (hθ : |θ| < 1 / 2) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (q : ℕ)
    (hker : ∀ r : ℕ, ‖schurKernel ((θ : ℂ)) (r + 1) q‖
      ≤ c * ((r : ℝ) + 1) ^ θ * ((q : ℝ) + 1) ^ (-θ) / ((r : ℝ) + 1 + q)) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ r ∈ range m, ‖schurKernel ((θ : ℂ)) (r + 1) q‖ * ((r : ℝ) + 1) ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ)
      ≤ (c / (1 / 2 - θ) + c / (1 / 2 + θ)) * ((q : ℝ) + 1) ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ)

name: InverseGenerator.schur_row_sum_le_of_kernel
statement:
theorem schur_row_sum_le_of_kernel {θ c : ℝ} (hθ : |θ| < 1 / 2) (hc : 0 ≤ c) {p : ℕ}
    (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hker : ∀ q : ℕ, ‖schurKernel ((θ : ℂ)) p q‖
      ≤ c * (p : ℝ) ^ θ * ((q : ℝ) + 1) ^ (-θ) / ((p : ℝ) + q)) (k : ℕ) :
    ∑ q ∈ range k, ‖schurKernel ((θ : ℂ)) p q‖ * ((q : ℝ) + 1) ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ)
      ≤ (c / (1 / 2 - θ) + c / (1 / 2 + θ)) * (p : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2) : ℝ)

name: InverseGenerator.blockSynth_eq
statement:
theorem blockSynth_eq (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) :
    blockSynth n α = fromBlocks (toeplitz n ((α / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (toeplitz n ((α / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) (toeplitz n (-((α / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      (-toeplitz n (-((α / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)))

name: InverseGenerator.blockSynth_inv_eq
statement:
theorem blockSynth_inv_eq (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) :
    (blockSynth n α)⁻¹ = (2⁻¹ : ℂ) • fromBlocks (toeplitz n (-((α / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      (toeplitz n ((α / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) (toeplitz n (-((α / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)))
      (-toeplitz n ((α / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))

name: InverseGenerator.blockSynth_zero
statement: theorem blockSynth_zero (n : ℕ) : blockSynth n 0 = rot2 n

name: InverseGenerator.blockSynth_zero_inv
statement: theorem blockSynth_zero_inv (n : ℕ) : (blockSynth n 0)⁻¹ = (2⁻¹ : ℂ) • rot2 n

name: InverseGenerator.conj_diagonal_zIndex_eq_sum
statement:
theorem conj_diagonal_zIndex_eq_sum (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (f : ℕ → ℂ) :
    blockSynth n α * Matrix.diagonal (fun s => f (zIndex s)) * (blockSynth n α)⁻¹
      = ∑ k ∈ range (2 * n), f k • coordProjZ n α k

name: InverseGenerator.coordProjZ_eq_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem coordProjZ_eq_vecMulVec (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (k : Fin n) :
    coordProjZ n α (2 * (k : ℕ))
      = Matrix.vecMulVec (fun s => blockSynth n α s (Sum.inl k))
          (fun t => (blockSynth n α)⁻¹ (Sum.inl k) t)

name: InverseGenerator.diagonal_zIndex_eq_sum
statement:
theorem diagonal_zIndex_eq_sum (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ) :
    Matrix.diagonal (fun s : Fin n ⊕ Fin n => f (zIndex s))
      = ∑ k ∈ range (2 * n),
          f k • Matrix.diagonal (fun s => if zIndex s = k then (1 : ℂ) else 0)

name: InverseGenerator.fromBlocks_sub_diag
statement:
theorem fromBlocks_sub_diag {ι κ : Type*}
    (A A' : Matrix ι ι ℂ) (D D' : Matrix κ κ ℂ) :
    Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 D - Matrix.fromBlocks A' 0 0 D'
      = Matrix.fromBlocks (A - A') 0 0 (D - D')

name: InverseGenerator.half_abs_lt
statement: theorem half_abs_lt {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) : |α / 2| < 1 / 2

name: InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_conj_rot2_diag_le
statement:
theorem l2_opNorm_conj_rot2_diag_le {n : ℕ} (f : ℕ → ℂ) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hf : ∀ s : Fin n ⊕ Fin n, ‖f (zIndex s)‖ ≤ B) :
    ‖blockSynth n 0 * Matrix.diagonal (fun s => f (zIndex s)) * (blockSynth n 0)⁻¹‖
      ≤ B

name: InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_coordProjZ_sub_le
InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_fromBlocks_diag_le
InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_multiplier_le
statement:
theorem l2_opNorm_multiplier_le {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (n : ℕ)
    (f : ℕ → ℂ) {B : ℝ} (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hbd : ∀ s : Fin n ⊕ Fin n, ‖f (zIndex s)‖ ≤ B) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ range (2 * n), f k • coordProjZ n α k‖
      ≤ B + 5 * α / (1 - α) * ∑ k ∈ range (2 * n - 1), ‖f (k + 1) - f k‖

name: InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_prefixZ_sub_even_le
InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_prefixZ_sub_le
InverseGenerator.l2_opNorm_vecMulVec_le
statement:
theorem l2_opNorm_vecMulVec_le (x : m₁ → ℂ) (y : m₂ → ℂ) :
    ‖Matrix.vecMulVec x y‖
      ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ i, ‖x i‖ ^ 2) * Real.sqrt (∑ j, ‖y j‖ ^ 2)

name: InverseGenerator.prefixZ_even
statement:
theorem prefixZ_even (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    prefixZ n α (2 * k)
      = Matrix.fromBlocks (prefixConj n k (((α / 2 : ℝ)) : ℂ)) 0 0
          (prefixConj n k (-((α / 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)))

name: InverseGenerator.prefixZ_full
statement: theorem prefixZ_full (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) : prefixZ n α (2 * n) = 1

name: InverseGenerator.prefixZ_odd
statement:
theorem prefixZ_odd (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    prefixZ n α (2 * k + 1) = prefixZ n α (2 * k) + coordProjZ n α (2 * k)

name: InverseGenerator.rot2_mulVec_inl
statement:
theorem rot2_mulVec_inl {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n ⊕ Fin n → ℂ) (i : Fin n) :
    (rot2 n).mulVec y (Sum.inl i) = y (Sum.inl i) + y (Sum.inr i)

name: InverseGenerator.rot2_mulVec_inr
statement:
theorem rot2_mulVec_inr {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n ⊕ Fin n → ℂ) (i : Fin n) :
    (rot2 n).mulVec y (Sum.inr i) = y (Sum.inl i) - y (Sum.inr i)

name: InverseGenerator.rotSynth_inv
statement:
theorem rotSynth_inv (n : ℕ) (β γ : K) :
    (rotSynth n β γ)⁻¹
      = (2⁻¹ : K) • fromBlocks (toeplitz n (-β)) (toeplitz n γ)
          (toeplitz n (-β)) (-toeplitz n γ)

name: InverseGenerator.sharpPrefixConst_half_le
statement:
theorem sharpPrefixConst_half_le {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) :
    sharpPrefixConst (α / 2) ≤ 3 * α / (1 - α)

name: InverseGenerator.sharpPrefixConst_neg
statement: theorem sharpPrefixConst_neg (θ : ℝ) : sharpPrefixConst (-θ) = sharpPrefixConst θ

name: InverseGenerator.sum_coordProjZ
statement:
theorem sum_coordProjZ (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (K : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range K, coordProjZ n α k = prefixZ n α K

name: InverseGenerator.sum_coordProjZ_sub
statement:
theorem sum_coordProjZ_sub (n : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (K : ℕ) :
    ∑ k ∈ range K, (coordProjZ n α k - coordProjZ n 0 k)
      = prefixZ n α K - prefixZ n 0 K

name: InverseGenerator.sum_sq_le_add_of_support
statement:
theorem sum_sq_le_add_of_support {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b b₀ : ι → ℂ)
    (h : ∀ i, b₀ i = 0 ∨ b i = b₀ i) :
    ∑ i, ‖b i‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ i, ‖b₀ i‖ ^ 2) + ∑ i, ‖b i - b₀ i‖ ^ 2

name: InverseGenerator.sum_sq_mulVec_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_mulVec_le (A : Matrix m₁ m₂ ℂ) (x : m₂ → ℂ) :
    ∑ p, ‖∑ q, A p q * x q‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖A‖ ^ 2 * ∑ q, ‖x q‖ ^ 2

name: InverseGenerator.sum_sq_one_col
statement:
theorem sum_sq_one_col {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, ‖(1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) i k‖ ^ 2 = 1

name: InverseGenerator.sum_sq_one_row
statement:
theorem sum_sq_one_row {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) :
    ∑ j : Fin n, ‖(1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) k j‖ ^ 2 = 1

name: InverseGenerator.sum_sq_rot2_mulVec
statement:
theorem sum_sq_rot2_mulVec {n : ℕ} (y : Fin n ⊕ Fin n → ℂ) :
    ∑ s, ‖(rot2 n).mulVec y s‖ ^ 2 = 2 * ∑ s, ‖y s‖ ^ 2

name: InverseGenerator.sum_sq_synthCol_sub_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_synthCol_sub_le {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) :
    ∑ s : Fin n ⊕ Fin n,
        ‖blockSynth n α s (Sum.inl k) - blockSynth n 0 s (Sum.inl k)‖ ^ 2
      ≤ tailSq α

name: InverseGenerator.sum_sq_synthCol_zero
statement:
theorem sum_sq_synthCol_zero {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) :
    ∑ s : Fin n ⊕ Fin n, ‖blockSynth n 0 s (Sum.inl k)‖ ^ 2 = 2

name: InverseGenerator.sum_sq_synthRow_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_synthRow_le {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) :
    ∑ t : Fin n ⊕ Fin n, ‖(blockSynth n α)⁻¹ (Sum.inl k) t‖ ^ 2
      ≤ 1 / (2 * (1 - α))

name: InverseGenerator.sum_sq_synthRow_sub_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_synthRow_sub_le {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) :
    ∑ t : Fin n ⊕ Fin n,
        ‖(blockSynth n α)⁻¹ (Sum.inl k) t - (blockSynth n 0)⁻¹ (Sum.inl k) t‖ ^ 2
      ≤ tailSq α / 4

name: InverseGenerator.sum_sq_synthRow_zero
statement:
theorem sum_sq_synthRow_zero {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) :
    ∑ t : Fin n ⊕ Fin n, ‖(blockSynth n 0)⁻¹ (Sum.inl k) t‖ ^ 2 = 1 / 2

name: InverseGenerator.sum_sq_toeplitz_col_sub_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_toeplitz_col_sub_le {θ C : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ m : ℕ, ∑ r ∈ Icc 1 m, binomCoeff r θ ^ 2 ≤ C) {n : ℕ} (k : Fin n) :
    ∑ i : Fin n, ‖toeplitz n ((θ : ℂ)) i k - (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) i k‖ ^ 2
      ≤ C

name: InverseGenerator.sum_sq_toeplitz_row_sub_le
statement:
theorem sum_sq_toeplitz_row_sub_le {θ C : ℝ}
    (hC : ∀ m : ℕ, ∑ r ∈ Icc 1 m, binomCoeff r θ ^ 2 ≤ C) {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    ∑ j : Fin n, ‖toeplitz n ((θ : ℂ)) i j - (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) i j‖ ^ 2
      ≤ C

name: InverseGenerator.tailSq_le
statement:
theorem tailSq_le {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α < 1) :
    tailSq α ≤ 13 * α ^ 2 / (8 * (1 - α))

name: InverseGenerator.tailSq_nonneg
statement: theorem tailSq_nonneg {α : ℝ} (hα1 : α < 1) : 0 ≤ tailSq α

name: InverseGenerator.tail_half_neg
statement:
theorem tail_half_neg {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ r ∈ Icc 1 m, binomCoeff r (-(α / 2)) ^ 2 ≤ α ^ 2 / 2

name: InverseGenerator.tail_half_pos
statement:
theorem tail_half_pos {α : ℝ} (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ r ∈ Icc 1 m, binomCoeff r (α / 2) ^ 2 ≤ 9 * α ^ 2 / (8 * (1 - α))

name: InverseGenerator.toeplitz_sub_one_apply
statement:
theorem toeplitz_sub_one_apply (θ : ℝ) {n : ℕ} (i k : Fin n) :
    toeplitz n ((θ : ℂ)) i k - (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) i k
      = ((if (k : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) then binomCoeff ((i : ℕ) - (k : ℕ)) θ else 0 : ℝ) : ℂ)

name: InverseGenerator.vecMulVec_sub_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_sub_vecMulVec {ι κ : Type*}
    (a a₀ : ι → ℂ) (b b₀ : κ → ℂ) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec a b - Matrix.vecMulVec a₀ b₀
      = Matrix.vecMulVec (a - a₀) b + Matrix.vecMulVec a₀ (b - b₀)

name: InverseGenerator.zIndex_lt
statement: theorem zIndex_lt {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n ⊕ Fin n) : zIndex s < 2 * n
